name: Moonlighters
source:
Dane moves to the small coastal town of Luminae, British Columbia in hopes of being able to put his past behind him and start things fresh. However, being what he calls a Moonlighter -a person who can see hotspots of intense emotions brought back to life in the moonlight- with a bad case of insomnia, makes it hard to keep the past out of his present. When the mysterious man Silas, an almost ghost-like being that seems to be a living memory with none of his own, suddenly starts appearing and talking to Dane every night, he finds that he can't help but step forward into the mysteries his powers present.
